'''The Rebel Alliance is increasing in Force''' is a Decipher advertisement for Star Wars CCG Premiere in ''[[The Duelist]]'' #12 (September 1996).<ref name="duelist12exp" />

[[File:Duelist 12 Expand The Empire.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Duelist #12 Premiere Expand The Empire advertisement.]]

The same issue also ran [[The Galaxy in a Box (The Duelist)|The Galaxy in a Box]] two-player advertisement.

<blockquote>
'''The Rebel Alliance is increasing in Force.'''<br />
'''What's your next move?'''

{{CardLink|Expand The Empire}}

With the ''Star Wars''® Customizable Card Game™ by Decipher, it's your strategy that controls the outcome. Will the Galactic Empire expand? It's your decision. Will the dark side of the Force triumph? That remains to be seen. With 324 customizable cards the choices are yours. Available in Starter Sets and Expansion Sets everywhere.

'''STAR WARS'''<br />
'''CUSTOMIZABLE CARD GAME'''<br />
DECIPHER INC.<br />
The Art of Great Games

TM & © 1996 Lucasfilm Ltd. All Rights Reserved. Used under authorization by Decipher Inc. TM, ® & © 1996 Decipher Inc. All Rights Reserved.
</blockquote>
